key_findings.themes_orphaned_route: Themes screen exists as ActiveScreen.themes but has NO sidebar navigation item. Only accessible via Settings > Appearance > Manage Themes or ils://themes deep link.
key_findings.home_layout_already_correct: Quick actions grid is ALREADY above recent sessions in HomeView (REQ-09 likely passes).
key_findings.security_issue: MCPServerDetailView.swift shows environment variables (including API keys) in plain text. Backend masks values but iOS renders them unmasked.
key_findings.no_hooks_ui: HooksConfig is fully modeled in ClaudeConfig.swift with 5 lifecycle events, but no HooksManagementView exists. REQ-06 requires new feature.
key_findings.fleet_debug_only: Fleet is gated behind #if DEBUG in SidebarView. Full UI (FleetManagementView, FleetHostDetailView, FleetViewModel) exists but is not accessible in release builds.
key_findings.teams_timer_inconsistency: TeamsViewModel uses Timer.scheduledTimer (3s) while FleetViewModel and MCPViewModel use Task-based polling. Inconsistent async patterns.
